tagline: A quiet, dignified Asian shore village directly below the Bosphorus Bridge — a summer palace, fresh fish restaurants, and local life at its most unhurried.

items.name: Beylerbeyi İskelesi Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A tea garden right at the waterfront with views of the Bosphorus Bridge looming above and boats passing below. Genuinely atmospheric.

items.name: Beylerbeyi Balık Restoranları
items.description: Several excellent fish restaurants on the waterfront. The Bosphorus Bridge looms overhead while you eat — one of Istanbul's most dramatic dining backdrops.
items.tip: Go at dinner when the bridge lights up — spectacular. The sea bass and turbot are consistently fresh.

items.name: Beylerbeyi Sarayı
items.description: A stunning 19th-century Ottoman summer palace on the Asian Bosphorus shore. Lavish interiors and beautiful gardens.

items.name: Bosphorus Bridge View
items.description: The waterfront directly below the Bosphorus Bridge offers one of Istanbul's most dramatic views. Walk along the shore for the best angles.

tips: Beylerbeyi is best reached by bus from Üsküdar or by ferry (seasonal service).
A very local, residential village — no tourist infrastructure to speak of. That's the point.
Combine with Çengelköy (further up the Asian Bosphorus) for a pleasant half-day.
The market streets above the waterfront are worth exploring for local shopping and food.
